intro: *This feed is updated so players can quickly see what's changed.*

notes: MAJOR = breaking player-facing structure or progression resets.
MINOR = new features/content visible to players.
PATCH = fixes, balancing, and polish with no major feature rollout.
Optional -tag for pre-release or rollout labels.

player_update_criteria: Gameplay, progression, economy, or reward behavior changed.
Menus, UX flows, or social systems players directly use changed.
New or updated content/events/decor/recipes visible in game.
internal_update_criteria: Dev tooling, refactor, test harness, infra, or cleanup only.
No player-visible behavior change in normal gameplay.

pinned.label: Latest Update
pinned.summary: Released premium perks and coin packs, plus official server giveaways and discovery/takeout reliability fixes.

changes: Launched premium perks: **24/7 House** (expanded order capacity + unlimited market stock behavior) and **Take Out Counter** (idle shift earnings).
Added coin-pack support across Discord SKU purchases and Stripe checkout metadata so rewards grant coins automatically.
Upgraded giveaway winner dev rewards to grant **Perks**, **Coin Packs**, or any direct **Coins** amount.
Improved reliability in takeout menu selection limits and coin-pack metadata resolution, with added regression coverage.
Revamped **Bot List Vote Rewards** with cleaner vote links and direct button shortcuts to each active vote site.
Updated vote rewards layout to make claiming easier, including a clearer **Claim All Vote Rewards** flow.
Friendly reminder: each valid vote can grant **1,000c + 300 SXP + 50 REP**. If you vote regularly, rewards stack up quickly!
Added dedicated About & News menus with live counters for current servers & active noodle shops + a one-tap Join Support Server button.
Refined News layout to show **Latest Update**, **Previous Update**, then **Upcoming notes** & a **Seasonal Event Reminder**.
Expanded Seasonal lore & flavor in the **Season** menu.
Improved staff upgrade picker and embed readability for smoother staffing upgrades.
Enabled a notification for players once they reach 5000 REP: the **Seating** shop upgrade can unlock more orders on the order board.
6 **NEW** Premium Shop Specializations available for purchase in the store, each purchase includes **10,000c** for your shop.

sections.title: Upcoming Updates
